newsitem.title: GERMANY: BUNDESBANK POLL--ECONOMISTS SEE NO RATE CHANGE.
newsitem.headline: BUNDESBANK POLL--ECONOMISTS SEE NO RATE CHANGE.

text.p: Following are the results of a
poll of 10 economists on the expected outcome of this week's
Bundesbank council meeting. The poll was conducted on Monday.
1. Will the Bundesbank change its leading interest rates
this week?
Yes 0
No 10
2. Will there be a cut in the discount and lombard rates
later this year?
Yes 0
No 10
3. Will there be a rise in the discount and lombard rates
later this year?
Yes 0
No 10
4. Will there be another fixed tender at 3.00 percent this
Thursday?
Yes 10
No 0
Detailed results of the poll as follows:
